description: Worked on solar PV and electrical design, including inverters, transformers, cables, equipment ratings, protection, and single-line diagrams. Performed PVsyst simulations with 3D shading, loss analysis, and energy-yield estimation. Used ETAP for system modelling and fault analysis, conducted metro-site visits, and developed Python scripts for solar-generation monitoring.

Developed a responsive mobile frontend with distinct interfaces for users and administrators. Translated design prototypes into a functional mobile experience, managed APK bundling for testing, and implemented property browsing, listing management, and booking workflows.

Contributed frontend features using React.js, HTML, and CSS. Debugged UI/UX issues, implemented responsive design updates across devices, and participated in code reviews within a production development workflow.
